project_type: Next.js 16.3.5 App Router + TypeScript — full-stack (API routes as backend), no separate server
build_system: Next.js 16 with Turbopack by default. next build uses Turbopack. No custom webpack config exists, so builds use Turbopack cleanly. No src/ directory — app/ is at project root. Path alias @/* maps to ./*
test_framework: None configured. Verification is npm run build (must produce zero TypeScript errors) + npm run dev (must start without runtime errors).
verification_instructions: 1) Run 'npm install' first (node_modules does not exist yet). 2) Run 'npm run build' — must complete with zero TypeScript errors. 3) Run 'npm run dev' — must start and serve on http://localhost:3000 without runtime errors. 4) Manually test: landing page loads, login with demo@example.com/demo123 works, dashboard shows, resume upload works, analysis runs, results display in 6-tab layout.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell environment. node_modules does NOT exist yet — npm install must be run first. Next.js 16.3.5 uses Turbopack by default for both dev and build. CRITICAL: In Next.js 16, params and searchParams in pages/layouts/routes are Promises and must be awaited. cookies(), headers(), draftMode() are all async. The 'middleware' filename is deprecated — use 'proxy' instead. serverRuntimeConfig and publicRuntimeConfig are removed — use environment variables. Tailwind v4: use '@import tailwindcss' NOT '@tailwind base/components/utilities'. CSS config uses @theme{} block NOT tailwind.config.js. shadcn/ui manual install: components import cn from 'cn' package (new) OR from @/lib/utils. The project already has: @radix-ui/react-label, @radix-ui/react-slot, @radix-ui/react-tabs, class-variance-authority, clsx, framer-motion, lucide-react, mammoth, pdfjs-dist, tailwind-merge, @tailwindcss/postcss. Must still install: recharts, react-hook-form, zod, @hookform/resolvers, uuid, @types/uuid, bcryptjs, @types/bcryptjs, @radix-ui/react-dialog, @radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu, @radix-ui/react-progress, @radix-ui/react-scroll-area, @radix-ui/react-separator, @radix-ui/react-avatar, @radix-ui/react-tooltip, @radix-ui/react-select, @radix-ui/react-accordion, tw-animate-css, shadcn, cn.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: 'Read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing any code'. This is Next.js 16.3.5 — all dynamic APIs (cookies, headers, params, searchParams) are async-only Promises. Middleware renamed to proxy. No synchronous access allowed.
key_patterns: 1) Next.js 16 async params: export default async function Page({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) { const { id } = await params; }. 2) Next.js 16 async cookies: const cookieStore = await cookies(); const token = cookieStore.get('token'). 3) Route handlers: export async function GET(request: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }). 4) Tailwind v4 globals.css: '@import tailwindcss'; '@import tw-animate-css'; '@import shadcn/tailwind.css'; '@custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *))'; '@theme inline { --color-background: var(--background); ... }'; ':root { --background: oklch(...); ... }'. 5) shadcn/ui components: use cn from 'cn' package or re-export from lib/utils. 6) 'use client' required on every interactive component. 7) Server Components by default for layouts/pages. 8) API routes in app/api/*/route.ts, export named GET/POST/PUT/DELETE functions.
directory_structure: Root: next.config.ts, package.json, tsconfig.json, postcss.config.mjs, components.json, AGENTS.md, .env.example. No app/, components/, lib/, hooks/, types/ directories yet — all must be created. No node_modules — must run npm install first.
